deque<Pos> q;

void dfsAug(int x, int f) {
    if (x == N + 1) {
        bottleneck = f;
        found = true;
        return;
    }
    int tmp = N + 2;
    for (int y = 0; y <= N + 1; ++y) {
        if (flow[x][y] < cap[x][y]) {
            tmp = min(tmp, h[y]);
            if (h[x] == h[y] + 1) {
                path[++pathLen] = y;
                dfsAug(y, min(f, cap[x][y] - flow[x][y]));
                if (!live || found) return;
                path[pathLen--] = 0;
            }
        }
        if (flow[y][x] > 0) {
            tmp = min(tmp, h[y]);
            if (h[x] == h[y] + 1) {
                path[++pathLen] = -y;
                dfsAug(y, min(f, flow[y][x]));
                if (!live || found) return;
                path[pathLen--] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    if (tmp + 1 != h[x]) {
        --gapCnt[h[x]];
        if (gapCnt[h[x]] == 0) live = false;
        h[x] = tmp + 1;
        ++gapCnt[h[x]];
    }
}

bool findPath() {
    found = false;
    bottleneck = S;
    pathLen = 0;
    path[0] = 0;
    dfsAug(0, S);
    return found;
}

void applyFlow() {
    for (int i = 1; i <= pathLen; ++i) {
        if (path[i] > 0)
            flow[abs(path[i - 1])][path[i]] += bottleneck;
        else
            flow[-path[i]][abs(path[i - 1])] -= bottleneck;
    }
}

            int k = s[j] - '0';

                reach[nr][nc] = false;
                q.push_back({nr, nc, p.dis + 1});
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= M; ++i)

            memcpy(reach, baseReach, sizeof(baseReach));
            reach[i][j] = false;
            q.push_back({i, j, 0});

                Pos p = q.front(); q.pop_front();
                int x = p.r, y = p.c;
